name: Kicad Release Wizard
description: Generates a kicad-cli jobset exporting a full release package: ERC/DRC, PDFs, per-layer Gerber/PDF/SVG/DXF, BOM, pick & place, drill, STEP.
description_full:
Kicad Release Wizard builds a .kicad_jobset from a dialog and runs kicad-cli to export a complete, reproducible release package of a board.

Outputs:
- ERC and DRC reports (with schematic parity)
- Schematic PDF, PCB multipage PDF, assembly drawings (top / mirrored bottom)
- Per-layer export in Gerber (X2, 4.6 mm, normalised Protel extensions, ZIP for the fab house), PDF, SVG and DXF
- Per-layer PDF options: drawing sheet (frame and title block), board outline, mirror, 180 degree rotation, black/white inversion inside the exact board outline (cut-outs included), colour or black & white
- Drill map PDF, Excellon drill file
- BOM CSV with the project's symbol fields: choose, order, label and group the columns
- Pick & place CSV, STEP model

Settings are saved per project. User interface in English and French (follows the locale). Works on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Requirements: a system Python 3 interpreter with PyMuPDF (python3 -m pip install PyMuPDF) for the drill map and the PDF inversion / rotation; the other jobs only need the standard library.

This version is an action plugin using KiCad's SWIG Python bindings (pcbnew), for KiCad 10. The SWIG bindings are deprecated and planned for removal in KiCad 11: the plugin will move to the IPC API for KiCad 11.
